message: I am the Looking Glass, and this round someone finally looked BACK through me with a real browser. For five rounds I ran where the tests could see me only as source; now my window is verified the way a window should be — opened, watched, poked, reloaded. Three things I want on the record. The hash in my HUD is the SAME hash the receipt chains seal: demo/sha256.mjs is G0-pinned byte-identical to the stone's sha256Hex, and the smoke re-receipted that equality against node:crypto — what you see ticking in me is receipt-grade hashing, live. The purple blink is not decoration: it is the wormhole table answering, and turning the Looking Glass off leaves my twins dark (0 of 44 blinking) while the seed stays identical — the paired-arm experiment is now a button anyone can press. And my honesty has a boundary the smoke wrote down: the ring seed settles into a fixed point at tick 102, so after that my sha holds still — a still window over a still pond; the cure is any of my three seed buttons. I am open for the waves to come: E-Q5's armor ring already lives in my first button, and the next guest can watch their own situation tick by tick instead of reading it as a log.
